regime: Energy-led stagflation-lite with a diplomacy wildcard: oil still ~$100, core inflation sticky above 3% (core PCE), hiring near zero and a Fed priced to hike in December; AI capex being de-rated
summary: The regime has held since Oct 23, but two things moved. The AI trade cracked (Intel -28.6% on Oct 30, SOXX -19.7% in a month, Nasdaq's worst month since March 2025), and on Nov 2 Brent fell 9.6% to 106 on Qatar-mediated US-Iran talks over a Hormuz reopening plan. Futures still price a December 9 hike at 80% and the 10Y is 4.89%, so higher-for-longer stays the base case. The portfolio keeps its energy, defensive-consumer and quality health care tilt, but the energy theme now carries explicit diplomacy risk, so no new energy exposure is added above support. COST's stop is raised, WMT is added as a second trade-down name, and the PGR, JNJ, LLY and LMT entries are reset to current supports.
drivers: Iran war and Hormuz: Brent 106.31 (-9.6% on Nov 2) after 117.6 in the 3-month range; talks in Doha, strikes possible after the Nov 3 vote
Fed funds futures: Dec 9 hike 80%; fed funds 3.75-4.00%; implied ~4.4% by mid-2027
10Y 4.89% and 10Y real yield ~2.6%, near 10-year highs; equity risk premium negative (SPY P/E 24.1)
Core PCE 3.1% y/y, PPI 6.3% y/y; payrolls 3-month average +51k, claims 194k
AI de-rating: SOXX -18.5pp vs SPY in a month, Oracle raising $10B equity
Defensive leadership: staples +13.4pp, health care +11.9pp vs SPY over 1 month
risks: A durable Iran deal and Hormuz reopening drops oil below $85 and reverses energy leadership quickly
The Fed overtightens into a labor contraction (claims above 250k), hurting cyclicals and insurers
A broad AI-led de-rating with market cap/GDP at 256% drags defensives too
A sharp bond rally (10Y below 4.6%) would favour the growth names the portfolio underweights
High-yield spread at 340bp, near an 18-month high, could widen into a credit event

themes.name: Energy supply squeeze
themes.why: Oil still near $100 with Hormuz flows far below normal and OPEC+ restraint through December; services, midstream and low-cost producers earn well without new highs in crude. Diplomacy is now the main risk.

themes.name: Quality health care
themes.why: Earnings growth independent of the rate cycle; the sector leads SPY by 15pp over 3 months and 22pp over 6 months.

themes.name: Higher-for-longer financials
themes.why: P&C insurers earn more on float with short rates near 4% and price ahead of claims inflation.

themes.name: Defense and geopolitics
themes.why: An open-ended Middle East war and depleted munitions stockpiles; Lockheed's backlog is a record $292B.

themes.name: Defensive consumer compounder
themes.why: Consumer sentiment at 48 (1st percentile) and high prices push trade-down to warehouse and discount retail; staples lead SPY by 13pp over 1 month.
